rationale: learned_primal_dual-claude-agentic: lpd_iters=3, lpd_hidden=48, lpd_n_primal=5, lpd_n_dual=5, lpd_share_weights=False, lr=0.0007, lr_schedule=cosine, epochs=10, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=200, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, rationale=iter-17 empty-patch confirmation from BASE_ITER=16 (max-SSIM 0.9091). NOISE-VS-SIGNAL: iters 13-16 are the SAME config (lpd_iters=3,hidden=48,n_primal=5,n_dual=5,lr=7e-4,cosine,ep=10,train_n=200) yet SSIM moved 0.8938->0.8877->0.9008->0.9091 = a +-0.01 seed/GPU/init noise band, NOT a real lift; 0.9091 is the high end of that band. Regime-bounded: LPD is the 128-view SPARSE breast/demo champion (learned DC fills missing angles); on DENSE full-view real-helical Mayo there are no missing angles, so PSNR/RMSE sit at/below the LD-FBP floor (hr 0) despite SSIM ~0.91. Levers exhausted across 16 iters: lpd_iters(3/5/10 depth), lpd_hidden(4/48 capacity), n_primal/n_dual, lr, epochs, train_n all mapped, none clear hr 0. No in-budget lever can move hr off 0 (more unrolled iters=more projector calls, blows 20-min wall at ~1000s already, and cannot add PSNR the dense-FBP floor denies). Documents the LPD ceiling toward iter-20.
